Software Park station () is a future station on Line 13B of the Beijing Subway. It is expected to open in 2026 as part of the combined newly constructed section of the planned Lines 13A and 13B, known as the Yizi line. The name derives from the Zhongguancun Software Park which the station serves.
Location
The station is located under the east side of the intersection of Dongbeiwang West Road and Software Park South Street on the border of Malianwa Subdistrict and Shangdi Subdistricts in Haidian District.
Station features
The station will have an underground island platform.
History
On March 20, 2025, the Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources announced the naming plan for the expansion and upgrading project of Line 13, and planned to name the station as Software Park.
On April 5, 2025, the main structure of the station was topped out.
